First independently raised 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrences unknown.

Affected PR [#1319](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1319), exact merge `913db0624b8aa79b188ff17a7f5c4ae0c0f63965`, head `45d78849fb160e5a2b0290e768c9afee0baac995`. Preserve closed original #1308 and its one-PR history. This is a new bounded remainder, with at most two PRs in the new disjoint namespace below. Existing source/boundary #1085 and engineering #1086 remain separate.

Confirmed defect: `integrity_guards.py::require_new_output` checks only `Path.exists()`. Dangling symlinks return false. The actual `validate_controls.py` subsequently calls overwrite-capable `SUMMARY.write_text` and `LEDGER.write_text`. It follows dangling symlinks, creates their target outside its output vintage and publishes passed positive/negative/reproducibility results with exit0. The same guard is used by `reproduce_integrity_erratum.py`, whose final `write_bytes` is also overwrite-capable and whose admission occurs after calculation; the producer path is a source-inspected adjacent risk, not independently reproduced here.

Actual reproduction: in a managed detached exact-merge review slot, copy the unchanged control CLI, sibling guard, evaluation-inputs manifest, original complete assessments, both complete retained compressed outputs and original control directory into a private literal packet mirror. Keep real immutable Git access to historical commit `cbb829672d18801e4310c30896a7ddb13a79b451`. No credentials or mocks. For a fresh run ID `auditor-broken-summary`, create `erratum-summary-auditor-broken-summary.json` as a dangling symlink to an absent file in your own scratch outside the packet. Execute `python -B .../vintages/generator-integrity-erratum/validate_controls.py --run-id auditor-broken-summary`. Observed exit0 and passed controls; the previously absent outside target now contains a version1 summary. Repeat separately for `correction-ledger-auditor-broken-ledger.json`: exit0, outside target created containing the complete ledger. Never point this test at another worker or original evidence.

The Auditor also ran this actual control CLI twice with complete fresh normal fixtures: both pass. An ordinary existing summary sentinel rejects with nonzero exit before the run directory is created and preserves its original bytes. Removing the required second retained run rejects with no output. An initial incomplete private fixture lacking the original controls parent failed honestly before publication; that failed attempt is retained and is not counted as a passing control.

Positive evidence to preserve: all27 changed whole files/modes are identical at head/merge, 184,916 raw bytes. All17 complete historical input/baseline encoded pins authenticated. Both full corrected report bodies agree. Independent complete row comparison confirms exactly16 null-to-source changes, exactlyfour Agar subjects, equal subject key sets and order, all27 province assessments unchanged, classifications0 justified/11 correction-needed/213 insufficient-evidence, Sheopur unresolved. The roster correction is not alleged false. Archived actually loaded helpers match historical pins. Original files and Git tracked content remained unchanged throughout six successful/adverse CLI executions.

Success criteria:

- Preserve every original packet, script, input/output/control, date and hash, closed #1308 history and corrected roster bindings. Add new immutable evidence under only the owned namespace; never regenerate retained vintages in place.
- Admit the entire fresh producer/control output set and all ancestor paths before expensive computation or mutation. Reject ordinary existing files/directories, live or dangling symlinks, path traversal and destinations escaping the declared owned prefix. Use exclusive creation and preserve original sentinels/targets, including failures after computation.
- Exercise both the actual producer and its actual control writer, using separate fresh run names twice, meaningful ordinary/broken/live symlink and ancestor/escaped destination cases, missing inputs and failed attempts. Publication/completion receipt must be last and match every admitted whole product; failed attempts must never be reported passed.
- Preserve complete224-subject/27-group roster and original scientific/classification results, including the exact four Agar subjects and16 corrected fields, unresolved Sheopur, source6822 vs metadata6836 discrepancy and all legal/current-boundary/source-rights unknowns. Bind consumed original inputs and executed archived methods truthfully. If full scientific replay cannot satisfy complete phase/file admission, record that limit and a legitimate complete method; streaming/fragment extraction cannot stand in for complete proof.
